# 9KARET

> 9KARET ("Smart Gold") is an Indian jewellery brand selling BIS-hallmarked 9K gold jewellery set with genuine gemstones online at 9karet.com, with delivery across India. It is operated by Goldbox Diamonds Private Limited, Mumbai, Maharashtra.

- Every piece is made in BIS-hallmarked 9K gold (37.5% pure gold), in yellow, rose or white gold.
- Set with genuine gemstones such as ruby, emerald and sapphire, plus cubic zirconia in some designs; each product page lists every stone with its count and weight.
- Transparent pricing: gold at the live 9K rate + gemstone value + making charge + 3% GST, shown as a full breakup on every product.
- Free shipping across India through insured, tracked partners (unless a delivery charge is shown at checkout). Most pieces are made to order: usually 4–5 days to make, then 3–4 days in transit.
- 7-day returns with free pickup for eligible products. Custom and engraved pieces are not returnable.
- Exchange and buyback on eligible jewellery, subject to the conditions shown at purchase.
- Contact: info@9karet.com. Registered office: No 281/287, 39 1-3, Narsi Natha Street, Princess Dock, Mumbai – 400009, Maharashtra, India.
